summary:
Main
Today brought two bearish threads and one clear floor beneath them. The first is fundamental: maintenance losses have been revised up again- on SMM's latest review basis, hot metal lost to blast furnace maintenance is 1.5267 million mt this week (Sep 19 25), up 56,000 mt WoW, rising a further 46,600 mt to 1.5733 million next week (Sep 26-Oct 2), each figure 24,500 mt above the Sep 21 weekly summary. Set against the Sep 14 print (1.4157 million this week, falling to 1.3734 million next), the direction has completely reversed: sustained mill losses are translating into steadily wider output cuts, and SMM says explicitly that the support this gives ore prices is weakening.
